purpose: Actual desktop gameplay showcase from the measured build; viewing copies are not a frame-timing benchmark.

source.label: Primary-monitor Desktop Duplication recording
source.limits: Requested 180-Hz capture was not achieved uniformly. FFmpeg corrected non-monotonic DTS values. Preserve the original privately; use the separate PresentMon window for rate conclusions.

edit.description: Crop the black side margins, resize, resample timestamps to 60 or 120 FPS, strip source metadata. No optical interpolation. Resampling can duplicate or drop frames.
edit.command_template: ffmpeg -i INPUT.mp4 -vf crop=1920:1440:320:0,scale=960:720:flags=lanczos,fps=RATE -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 22 -profile:v high -level:v LEVEL -pix_fmt yuv420p -an -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart OUTPUT.mp4

measurement_relation: Recorded before, not during, the final 65.02-second 120-target measurement. Same game session and unmodified JS/WASM.

validation.decode: Both viewing copies decoded without FFmpeg errors.
